passage:
community — 社区
In the small town of Riverton, a community garden was created five years ago.

council — 委员会，议会
Last year, the town council decided to add new technology: a website where people could book garden plots online, and a camera to watch the garden at night.

privacy — 隐私
If we don’t have a rule, people will worry.” The council agreed to write a privacy policy.

policy — 政策，规定
If we don’t have a rule, people will worry.” The council agreed to write a privacy policy.

record — 记录，录制
They worried that the camera would record their faces and that their personal information might be shared.

deleted — 删除
The recordings would be deleted after seven days.

trust — 信任
I think that the policy is fair.” Ahmed added, “If the council keeps its promise, we can trust the technology.” The garden now has fifty families, and the website is used every day.

solutions — 解决方案
When people discuss their worries and listen to each other, they can find solutions that work for everyone.
